cat > /run/post-reboot-anonymous-write-test.ldif <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
dn: uid=alex,ou=people,dc=branch,dc=test
changetype: modify
add: description
description: post-reboot-anonymous-write-must-fail
ANTRIEB_EOF
set +e
ANON_OUTPUT=$(ldapmodify -x -H "ldap://$NODE1_IP" -f /run/post-reboot-anonymous-write-test.ldif 2>&1)
ANON_RC=$?
set -e
printf '%s\n' "$ANON_OUTPUT"
printf 'anonymous_write_exit=%s\n' "$ANON_RC"
[ "$ANON_RC" -ne 0 ]
if ldapsearch -x -LLL -H "ldap://$NODE1_IP" -b 'uid=alex,ou=people,dc=branch,dc=test' -s base description | grep '^description:'; then exit 1; fi
printf 'post_reboot_anonymous_write_preserved_entry=yes\n'
